fields.name: summary
fields.description: One-sentence summary of what changes this file contains.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Type of change: feature (new functionality), refactor (no behavior change), bugfix, test, docs, config, build, other.

fields.name: needs_review
fields.description: True if this file's changes warrant careful human review (non-trivial logic, security-sensitive code, public API change). False for cosmetic or auto-generated changes.

fields.name: breaks_api
fields.description: True if this change modifies a public function signature, removes an exported symbol, or changes a behavior contract that external callers may rely on.

fields.name: test_coverage
fields.description: How well-tested this change is: covered (tests exist for the new code), partial (some paths tested), none (no tests touch this), n/a (file is itself a test).

fields.name: risks
fields.description: Up to 5 specific risks this change introduces. Each item is a short phrase: 'race condition between X and Y', 'silently swallows errors', 'changes default behavior'.
